summary: Five ordered tasks reuse the existing controller, EmployeeService and in-memory map. T1 adds the optional department field to Employee and CreateEmployeeRequest. T2 adds trimmed, case-insensitive exact filtering in the service and an optional department query parameter in the controller, and replaces the no-arg findAll() with findAll(String department). T3 adds tests and updates the OpenAPI assertions. T4 updates docs/api-docs.md behind a human-review gate. T5 runs the focused and full Maven validation. No database, service, framework or dependency is added. Planning approval is pending.
decisions: approval: pending - Planning approval for Development has not been given. This completed handoff is not approval to begin development.

Recorded human approval: Requirements (run-003) APPROVED with the amendment 'Trim surrounding spaces before matching'. The department query value is trimmed before the case-insensitive exact match. Empty after trim returns HTTP 200 []. Omitted returns all employees. Unknown returns HTTP 200 [].
Recorded human approval: Design Review (run-003) APPROVED, including its three non-blocking corrections, which are folded into tasks T2, T3 and T4.

Prerequisite check: the three input handoffs are valid JSON with stages requirements, architecture and design-review, status completed and empty blockers. implementation-plan.json did not previously exist in run-003. The repo has no mvnw wrapper, so plain mvn is used.

Correction 1 (concrete choice): remove the no-argument EmployeeService.findAll() and replace it with findAll(String department). The controller is the only caller, so no delegating method is kept and there is no dead code.

T1 - Add optional department field. Depends on: none. Files: src/main/java/com/example/employeeapidocsync/Employee.java, src/main/java/com/example/employeeapidocsync/CreateEmployeeRequest.java. Work: add 'String department' as the last record component of both, with @Schema(description, nullable) metadata only and no validation annotations. Completion: both records compile with department; POST bodies without department still bind with department null; EmployeeService.create is the only 'new Employee(' call site and is updated in T2.

T2 - Service filtering and controller parameter. Depends on: T1. Files: src/main/java/com/example/employeeapidocsync/EmployeeService.java, src/main/java/com/example/employeeapidocsync/EmployeeController.java. Work: (a) create passes request.department() unchanged to new Employee(nextId++, name, email, department), with no trimming or case normalization on storage. (b) Replace findAll() with synchronized findAll(String department): if department == null return all employees in insertion order; else trimmed = department.trim(); if trimmed.isEmpty() return List.of(); else return employees whose department is non-null and equalsIgnoreCase(trimmed), in insertion order. The null check comes before trim(). (c) The controller findAll takes @RequestParam(required = false) String department with an @Parameter(description) annotation and no defaultValue, and calls employeeService.findAll(department). The controller holds no filtering logic. Completion: project compiles; no references to the no-arg findAll() remain (grep); GET /api/employees/{id}, POST status codes and error bodies, ApiExceptionHandler and ErrorResponse are unchanged.

T3 - Tests. Depends on: T2. Files: src/test/java/com/example/employeeapidocsync/EmployeeApiDocSyncApplicationTests.java, src/test/java/com/example/employeeapidocsync/OpenApiDocumentationTests.java. Work in EmployeeApiDocSyncApplicationTests: add cases for filter match (AC1), case variation (AC2), surrounding-space trim such as ' IT ' matching 'IT', omitted parameter returns all (AC3), empty and whitespace-only each return 200 [] even when employees exist (AC4), unknown returns 200 [] (AC5), partial value like 'I' does not match 'IT' (AC6), POST with department returns 201 and echoes department, and POST without department returns 201 with the same id, name and email as before and department null (AC7). Correction 3: add a test that a department created with surrounding spaces is stored as given (response and GET by ID show the untrimmed value), and a test that an employee with null department appears in the unfiltered list but is excluded from a filtered result. Work in OpenApiDocumentationTests: change the exact property sets to Employee {id, name, email, department} and CreateEmployeeRequest {name, email, department}, and assert department is an optional (not required) string query parameter on GET /api/employees, with paths, operations and response codes unchanged (AC8). Completion: every case above exists and passes; existing GET by ID, POST validation and malformed-JSON tests are unmodified in intent and pass.

T4 - API documentation update behind the human-review gate. Depends on: T2. File: docs/api-docs.md. Work (Correction 2): document the optional department field in the Employee and CreateEmployeeRequest schemas (string, nullable, stored as given). Document the optional department query parameter on GET /api/employees with these rules: omitted returns all employees; the value is trimmed and matched case-insensitively and exactly; blank or whitespace-only returns 200 []; unknown returns 200 []. Add request and response examples covering POST with and without department, GET with department=IT, a case variation, and an empty-result case. Completion: the document matches the implemented behavior and the generated OpenAPI. Human-review gate: the Developer prepares the docs/api-docs.md change as a proposal and must not treat it as final until the human has reviewed and approved it. Do not make any Git changes.

T5 - Validation. Depends on: T3 and T4. No file changes. Focused command (no Maven wrapper in the repo, use mvn): mvn -Dtest=EmployeeApiDocSyncApplicationTests,OpenApiDocumentationTests test. Full regression: mvn test. Completion: both commands exit 0 with zero failures and zero errors, covering AC1-AC9. These commands are planned only and were not executed during Planning.

Scope guard: add no database, repository layer, new service, framework or dependency. Do not modify .github/, .claude/, hooks, prior run directories (run-001, run-002) or the run-003 input handoffs. Make no commit, push or PR without separate human approval.

Risks to watch in Development: do not set defaultValue on the request parameter, since it would collapse omitted and blank; Spring binds ?department= to an empty string, which T2 treats as blank. Only the filter value is trimmed; a stored department is compared as stored. Employees with null department never match a non-blank filter.
